name: klang-language
description: Syntax highlighting, the K language server (diagnostics as you type, hover, go to definition, symbols, semantic highlighting, signature help) and tasks for K.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Syntax highlighting, snippets and the outline work in Restricted Mode. Running the compiler requires a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: K uses a compiler and source files on the extension host's filesystem.

scripts.package: npm run bundle && vsce package --no-dependencies --out klang-language.vsix

keybindings.when: editorLangId == klang && editorTextFocus && isWorkspaceTrusted && config.klang.useRunKeybindings && debugState == inactive
editorLangId == klang && editorTextFocus && isWorkspaceTrusted && config.klang.useRunKeybindings && debugState == inactive

program.description: Entry file. Defaults to klang.entryFile or the active K file.

configurationSnippets.label: K: Run with JIT
configurationSnippets.description: Run K in a task terminal using the compiler's JIT (no debugger).

klang.compilerPath.description: Compiler executable or command on PATH. Empty searches klang and build/{Release,Debug}/klang in the workspace, then PATH. Relative paths use the workspace folder. Supports ${workspaceFolder}.

klang.entryFile.description: Program entry file, relative to the workspace folder. Empty checks/runs the current file. Set this when editing imported modules. Supports ${workspaceFolder}.

klang.stdlibPath.description: Standard-library directory passed as --stdlib. Empty uses the compiler's default lookup (including KLANG_STDLIB). Supports ${workspaceFolder}.

klang.useLanguageServer.description: Start the compiler's language server (klang lsp) for diagnostics as you type, hover, go to definition, symbols, semantic highlighting and signature help. A compiler without it, or this off, checks saved files instead (klang.checkOnSave).

klang.checkOnSave.description: Without the language server: check saved K files on open and save. Checks wait until open K files in the same workspace folder are saved.

klang.useRunKeybindings.description: Run with JIT on Ctrl+Shift+B (Cmd+Shift+B on macOS), F5, and Ctrl+F5 while editing K. Disable to use VS Code's usual task/debug keybindings.

klang.checkTimeout.description: Maximum time in milliseconds for a background compiler check.

klang.runArguments.description: Program arguments passed after -- by Run Program. Each item is one argument.

action.description: Compiler operation. Run uses the JIT and is the contributed build task; build makes an executable beside the source with `klang build`.

file.description: Source file relative to the workspace folder. Defaults to klang.entryFile or the active file. Supports ${workspaceFolder} and ${file}.

output.description: C output file for generateC; defaults to the source basename with .c.
